_comment: OpenWiki reads this file at run time to know which LangSmith workspaces + projects to pull traces from. The key itself is NEVER stored here — only its workspace region and project names. The API key is read from OPENWIKI_LANGSMITH_API_KEY at runtime.
_comment_2: Add an EU or APAC entry here if you document projects in multiple regions. Each entry gets its own key env var: OPENWIKI_LANGSMITH_API_KEY_2, _3, etc.
_comment_3: To document only what openwiki has already generated (skip LangSmith), set an empty projects array per workspace.
_comment_4: Traced but NOT claimed by OpenWiki: connector-derived facts (Gmail, Notion, Slack, etc.) — those belong in personal mode, not code mode.
_usage: Update this list whenever you add or remove a LangSmith project you want documented in the wiki.
